blocks.body:
## A 27.53% metadata reduction warrants one physical A/B, not a speedup claim

**CONDITIONAL GO after M519 R5.** The prior 27.5346% value is a favorable local metadata-movement upper bound. Missing an arbitrary 30% proxy gate does not prove poor area or power. The candidate may receive one clone-only matched implementation; it remains a C2 physical-efficiency submechanism and has no cycle or system-speedup claim.

## The minimum delta removes distributed tag state while preserving the stale-safe ticket

Leaf request, response, entry, comparator, and adapter slot copies lose tag24. The central eight-slot scoreboard retains tag24 and reconstructs it only after an exact `{epoch16, generation32, slot3}` and bank-mask match. Address18, K8, L4, O8/FIFO4, signed INT8, Acc24, bank traffic, and schedule remain unchanged.

## Scope and comparison basis

The A/B uses one parameterized top with identical ports, eight leaf shells, hard-SRAM boundaries, request/response trace, stalls, 3.0 ns clock, TSMC28 libraries, and logic-only accounting. A second flattened full-M519 K8 run prevents a local win from being presented as a full-FC2 result.

## Method: clone-only, fail-closed, and symmetric where used in the main table

The baseline files remain untouched. An independent static review precedes one exact-SHA VCS campaign; paired DC follows only after bit-exact legal traffic and eighteen stale/reorder/flush/reuse attack classes pass. If the K8-vs-K1x8 main row is updated, the same generic optimization must be offered to K1x8.

## Physical gates preserve a useful middle outcome

A transport-local area reduction of at least 15% or dynamic-power reduction of at least 20%, with sequential area down at least 10% and no full-top regression, promotes the mechanism inside C2. An 8–15% area or 10–20% power result remains an implementation detail rather than being discarded. Only a weak physical result or any correctness/timing failure closes the line.

## Limitations and uncertainty

No candidate RTL, VCS, area, timing, SAIF, PTPX, energy, or system measurement exists yet. Logical state and comparator counts can predict direction but not mapped-cell savings. The tag-elided protocol is stale-safe under the frozen epoch/generation/slot rules; it is not a cryptographic integrity mechanism.

## Recommended next step

Finish and seal M519 R5 first. Then author the clone-only candidate and matched wrapper, run an independent static hammer, and execute one VCS plus paired DC. Run SAIF/PTPX only if DC clears the physical gate.

## Further question

Will synthesis retain enough distributed tag state across the hard-SRAM leaf boundary to produce at least an 8% local physical gain? The matched hierarchy-preserved and flattened runs are designed to answer that without overstating system impact.

decision_gates.gate: local area ≥15% or dynamic power ≥20%; seq area ≥10%; full-top regression ≤1%; exact cycles/traffic
area 8–15% or dynamic power 10–20%; guardrails clean
area <8% and dynamic power <10%, or physical/cycle/traffic regression
